body.heading: Fold your plane
paragraphs: Your adult helps you fold a classic dart: fold in half, fold the corners to the middle, fold again.
Crease each fold firmly with your fingernail. Sharp folds fly straighter.

body.heading: Test and change
paragraphs: Stand at your start line and throw gently, with your arm pointing where you want it to go.
Measure the flight in footsteps. Change one fold and test again. That is how inventors work.

takeaway: A flat sheet of paper can fly, if you fold it cleverly.
safetyNotes: An adult helps with the folding; throw planes outside or in a clear room, never towards faces.
screenFreeExtension: Decorate your best plane and keep a chart of how far each design flies.
